title: Call Me Maybe: Does Customer Feedback Seeking Impact Nonsolicited Customers?
authors: Rupali Kaul; Stephen J. Anderson; Pradeep K. Chintagunta; Naufel J. Vilcassim
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with small businesses in Rwanda (feedback seeking); endline outcomes regressed on treatment with batch (stratum) FE, ANCOVA baseline controls and IV for compliance; consumer-level tapped/untapped comparisons. No staggered adoption or DiD.
design_notes: Endline_Main_Effects.do: areg y num_treat b_y, a(Batch_no) r; ivreg2 y (compliance_avg = num_treat). Consumer_Analysis.do: reg y Tapped Untapped, vce(cluster entrep_id).
software_notes: Stata for main tables; R Markdown for appendix.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
